propositions: rebar search returns complete ticket bodies and comments, causing excessive output (~203 KB) that exhausts agent context during discovery.
Search command lacks --output flag and canonical result schema, while list already supports include_body=False and --full opt-in for selective body inclusion.
Summary field is missing from the event/state schema; search must derive bounded summaries (max 240 chars) from descriptions until a durable summary is stored.

Search results must include bounded snippets (max 240 chars) showing the first matching free-text term in case-preserving context, extracted from any field (description, comment, tag, identifier) but never returning full bodies.

Default search output must validate against search_result.schema.json with eight discovery fields; --full returns legacy TicketState; --output llm returns minified NDJSON against search_result_llm.schema.json.
Predicate-only and negation-only queries must return null snippet; invalid --output values and --full --output=llm combinations must exit with code 2 and clear error messages.
